content: {"reasoning": "CO-197 is a prior-auth-missing denial. This payer offers no retroactive authorization and no peer-to-peer review, so those paths are closed. Resubmitting (clean or with records) would be a duplicate/pointless touch and risks CO-18. The only legitimate way to progress a prior-auth denial here is a formal appeal arguing medical necessity, which is permitted since a denial is on the table.", "action": "appeal_with_necessity"}
